:::{#exm-absolute-value}
#### Absolute values

- $\abs{2.5} = 2.5$, because $2.5 \ge 0$.
- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \abs{-3} &= -(-3) \\
  &= 3,
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  because $-3 < 0$.
- $\abs{0} = 0$.
- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \abs{-3} &= 3 \\
  &= \sqrt{9} \\
  &= \sqrt{(-3)^2}:
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  for every real $a$, $\abs{a} = \sqrt{a^2}$ (@def-square-root).
- $\abs{x - 1} < 1$ says that $x$ is less than $1$ away from $1$,
  that is, $0 < x < 2$.

:::
